mentions.name: EACL (Enterprise Access ControL)
mentions.description: EACL (Enterprise Access ControL) is a situated ReBAC authorization library inspired by SpiceDB, built in Clojure and backed by Datomic Pro, Datahike, Datalevin, or DataScript. Permissions are stored as data that co-exist with the application's data, which provides reduced network latency, strong local consistency, and opportunities for real-time view maintenance. It ships with a performance demo (1M permissioned entities, 3.8M relationships), an in-browser toy Google Drive clone, and handles authorization in the Datahike HTTP server; EACL V8 RC was released to Clojars.
